import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Total Sales by Product (Top Left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('YlOrBr', len(product_sales))
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group (Top Right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('Blues_d', len(age_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors2,
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales))
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Average Transaction by Size and Payment Method (Bottom Left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='payment_method', 
                            aggfunc='mean').reindex(size_order)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=sns.color_palette('Set2', 3), edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Avg Transaction by Size & Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Payment Method', loc='upper left')
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Daily Sales Trend (Bottom Right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()
ax4.fill_between(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], alpha=0.3, color='steelblue')
ax4.plot(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], color='steelblue', linewidth=1.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Daily Sales Trend Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add a moving average line
window = 7
daily_sales['ma'] = daily_sales['total'].rolling(window=window).mean()
ax4.plot(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['ma'], color='darkred', linewidth=2, 
         linestyle='--', label=f'{window}-day Moving Avg')
ax4.legend(loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
